verdict.why: kaikki-it-en reads economico as /e.koˈnɔ.mi.ko/; the model wrote /eˈkɔ.no.mi.ko/

draft.emotion: practical and satisfied, finding a good deal without sacrificing too much quality
notes: While 'economico' describes things that are inexpensive, it is often preferred over the word 'economico' by some who might use 'a buon mercato' to avoid the suggestion that something is merely 'cheap' or of poor quality.
Be careful not to confuse this with the English word 'economic', which refers to the economy or finances in general.

senses.definition: Something that costs very little money.

examples.text: Ho trovato un ristorante molto economico in centro.
examples.translation: I found a very inexpensive restaurant in the center.
examples.emotion: pleasantly surprised and eager to share the discovery

senses.definition: Something designed to save money or resources during use.

examples.text: Questa lavatrice è davvero economica nei consumi.

examples.emotion: approving and informative, highlighting a smart choice
